newsitem.title: USA: Anadigics prices 2.0 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Anadigics prices 2.0 mln shr offering.

text.p: Anadigics Inc said on Friday that it has priced the public offering of 2,041,513 shares of its common stock at $31.50 per share.
Anadigics said 1,875,000 shares were offered by the company and 166,513 were offered by selling stockholders.
In connection with the offering, Anadigics has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 306,226 common shares to cover over-allotments.
The offering reflects a 3-for-2 stock split as of the close of trading on February 20, 1997, the company said.
The settlement and closing of the offering is expected to take place on February 26, 1997, Anadigics said. Following the offering, Anadigics will have 14,481,943 shares outstanding.
Proceeds will be used to buy capital equipment, make leasehold improvements and for general corporate purposes, Anadigics said.
Goldman Sachs & Co managed the offering and Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Needham & Co Inc served as co-managers, Anadigics said.
